summary: The admitted case first diverges at segment 0 step 90 during the blessed polymorph duration cap. C min(u.mtimedone, rn2(15)+10) expands to a conditional macro and can evaluate its random argument twice; this history draws rn2(15)=13 for the condition then rn2(15)=12 for the selected false branch. The JS Math.min expression draws once, yielding 2686/2690 RNG calls while all 91 screens and cursors match. This is a divergence fix in potion.c:peffect_polymorph, not a new whole-source port.
